capabilities: Sync Dedao Brain notes into a vault folder as Markdown
Upload selected Markdown files to Dedao Brain
Search Dedao Brain from a sidebar and the editor context menu
Filter syncs by date, note, tag or knowledge base
Download attachments and organize files by created date
disambiguation: Not a device-to-device vault sync tool; it syncs notes between Obsidian and the Dedao Brain service.
extras: Plugin ID stays getnote-importer for compatibility with the existing listing; display name is Dedao Brain Sync. Web-mode login and token refresh are mainly desktop features, and automatic upload requires OpenAPI.
problem: Notes and highlights kept in Dedao Brain cannot be organized, linked or searched together with the rest of a vault.
summary: Two-way sync between Dedao Brain (GetNote) and Obsidian that saves notes, highlights, links and recordings as local Markdown files.
